violation_type.title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

violation_type.typical_finding: 10 children were missing special care needs information in their admission paperwork.

finding_variants.text: 10 children were missing special care needs information in their admission paperwork.
One child was missing the authorization for emergency medical attention.
One child lacked authorization for emergency medical care.
The admission forms did not include a special needs statement that was in accordance with minimum standards.
Three of the eight records reviewed did not have signed authorization to obtain emergency medical care or transport the child for emergency medical treatment.
The special care needs information was not included in the admissions form.
